name: promote_deliverable_baseline
description: Give the deliverable an IDENTITY. Promotes the shipped production-cascade output (run 65e53f071b45) as the named object `ko_imaging_deliverable` — content-addressed, sha'd, with provenance stamped on the manifest. Run ONCE to seed; thereafter every accepted change re-promotes the same name from ancestor-repair-selective, so the deliverable has a version history instead of being 'whichever run I remember'. Without this, when SME feedback returns against a CSV we cannot say which bytes they reviewed except by archaeology through run directories.
